name: connect-database-backup
description: What: Back up the Main database as the clean Connect baseline of the current run size (model, service configurations and strategies, no PData records). A bare file name lands in the SQL Server default backup directory. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/databases:ProfiseeDatabaseName, connect/instances:ProfiseeInstanceName, connect/machines:ApplicationServerName, connect/machines:DatabaseServerName. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inputs.name: SourceTableName
inputs.description: Source table label of the run size (PDATA), passed by the workload that runs this one.

inputs.name: ProfiseeVersionCode
inputs.description: TestAuto version code (data.tProfiseeVersion) the runs are recorded under; the automation tags, run profile codes and backup names carry it. Passed by the test that runs this one (connect/environment:ProfiseeVersionCode, or the lane's version).

inline.description: What: Back up {{ProfiseeDatabaseName}} to {{BackupFileName}} (overwrites the previous baseline of this version). Why: Backs up or restores the database so every run starts from the same known state (BackupDatabase). Success: SQL Server finishes the BackupDatabase of the database with the named file in its default backup folder. If it fails: Check the backup file exists in the SQL Server default backup folder of the database server, the disk has room, and the CrewChief account is sysadmin there.
